caseSYNTH001.description: Synthetic, unpacked WhatsApp chat exports from Android and iOS with entirely fabricated values, generated by admin/test/scripts/gen_whatsapp_export_synth.py. No real export data: an export is a person's conversation. File names, line prefixes, attachment markers and invisible characters follow real English-language exports from both platforms. Covers one-to-one chats on both platforms that agree on the owner, so the groups get a Direction; Android system lines without a sender, phone-number senders, an attachment with a caption on the next line, a voice note, a document with its own name and a media file no message names; iOS CRLF, U+200E marks, '~ name' with U+202F, a number wrapped in U+202A/U+202C, a group system message under the group's name, an empty message, and an attachment missing from the export; a chat whose dates never settle day and month order; continuation lines; and a WhatsApp*.txt holding no message.

last_commit.message: Preserve return timestamps and retain complete message records
